# Slates

Slates is a desktop AI video studio you buy once and keep. This plugin connects your AI to it, so your AI can run the whole production with you. It writes the script, builds characters and storyboards, shows you the price before anything generates, makes the images and video, and lays the cut out on the timeline, ready to export to DaVinci Resolve or Premiere. Every project and file stays on your own computer.

You need the Slates desktop app on Windows or macOS and a Slates account with credits. If the app isn't set up yet, the plugin walks you through installing and connecting it, then hands the work to the Slates tools.

## What you need

Keep the Slates desktop app running while your AI works on your projects. If it isn't installed or connected yet, the bundled `slates-connect` skill walks you through it.

## Install

Install this plugin from the Claude directory.

If you connected Slates from the app's Settings before, remove that older `slates` server registration so the tools are not listed twice.

## Bundled skills

- **slates-connect**: Install, open, connect, or repair Slates when its slates_* tools are missing or fail to reach the desktop app. Do not use when Slates tools already work; continue with the user's request instead.
- **slates-project-organization**: Navigate and organize Slates projects, asset codes such as IMG-A12 or VID-V3, folders, Library references and templates. Use when locating media, preparing a reusable production or keeping a project legible.
- **slates-script-craft**: Write or revise script passages, openings, bridges and saved variations while preserving voice, format and fixed material. Use for writing within a production brief or a writing-only request.
- **slates-storyboard-from-script**: Save a supplied script or treatment as an editable Slates document and bind production passages to shots. Use when preparing a storyboard while preserving the words, structure and requested scope.
- **slates-shot-variety**: Shape visual rhythm across a shot sequence or diagnose unintended sameness. Use while planning or reviewing cuts; preserve deliberate repetition, continuing performance and the chosen format.
- **slates-one-prompt-film**: Turn a video brief into a finished, editable Slates production and verified export. Use for requests to make a film, short, trailer, music video, ad or other complete video, entering through writing, imported footage or an existing edit.
- **slates-edit-and-iterate**: Refine an existing Slates image with a targeted edit or revised generation. Use for changes such as warmer light, removing a figure, reframing or a different look; preserve the original and its lineage.
- **slates-direct-response-ad**: Develop a product-led direct-response ad from an offer and references. Use for demonstrations, proof, argument and the next action; combine with script craft and presenter direction as needed.
- **slates-ugc-influencer-ad**: Direct a creator-style spoken ad when the brief calls for a camera-facing person or exchange. Covers activity, performance, phone-camera handling, speech, interaction and sound.
